newsitem.title: AFGHANISTAN: New Afghan rulers run tank over bottles of alcohol.
newsitem.headline: New Afghan rulers run tank over bottles of alcohol.

text.p: Afghanistan's new islamic rulers on Saturday used a tank to crush hundreds of bottles of alcohol and dozens of cartons of beer to show their abhorrence of drink.

The foreign media, accused a day earlier of running a propaganda campaign against the Taleban militia which took Kabul on September 27 and immediately started imposing islamic law, was invited to watch and film the destruction.

The Taleban, whose priest-led movement was founded two years ago in religious schools in refugee camps in Pakistan, barred films, television, music and drinking and decreed that men should grow beards and not trim them.
They said Islamic Sharia laws would be imposed that permit amputation for thieves, stoning to death for adulterers and harsh, but unspecified, punishments for drinkers and drug takers.

Taleban officials said the alcoholic drinks destroyed on Saturday were confiscated from the Intercontinental Hotel, Kabul's only functioning big hotel and now home to scores of their Taleban colleagues.
The drink was gathered on a dusty hillside on the northern outskirts of Kabul and the tank was rolled in to crush it.
Children moved in after the Taleban left to see whether anything was left to be salvaged. One was successful, finding an undamaged can of beer.
